name: module_bridge
title: An authorized stream reaches a module program
summary: yumed authorizes the OPEN and connects to the module's socket, which a service manager owns. The module runs as a user of its own.

nodes.title: Client
nodes.note: Opens a configured byte-stream service without a destination, for example through a local forward or the C ABI.

nodes.title: yumed
nodes.note: Checks the authenticated identity's service grant before handing the stream to its module adapter.

nodes.title: Module bridge
nodes.note: Connects to the module's socket, which only the daemon's user can reach, and writes the version, identity and service header before the stream bytes. It preserves both half-closes.

nodes.title: Module program
nodes.note: Accepts the connection and serves it without linking YUME. systemd runs it as a user of its own with the socket as descriptor 3, so it cannot read the daemon's credential files.
